prs.location:
Set on Dublin's southern waterfront in Dublin 4, Sand House places you where the city meets the sea. Grand Canal Dock and the city's Central Business District are within easy walking distance, while the DART and city-centre connections put the rest of Dublin within easy reach.

Right on your doorstep, Dublin Bay and the Irishtown Nature Reserve open onto miles of coastline — perfect for sea swimming, paddle-boarding, cycling or a morning walk along the strand. Sandymount Village, with its cafés, restaurants and green, is just moments away, and the shops, bars and culture of the city centre are only a short journey from home.

This is coastal living with the city at your fingertips — the best of both, in one of Dublin's most connected waterfront neighbourhoods.

City living shaped by the sea, Sand House is a collection of 172 fully furnished studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom rental homes at the heart of the Glass Bottle waterfront in Dublin 4, moments from Grand Canal Dock, the city's Central Business District and the coast.

Every apartment is designed around modern living, with floor-to-ceiling windows and a private balcony framing views across the city, coast and mountains. Interiors are finished to a high standard throughout — a contemporary two-tone kitchen with solid worktops and integrated Neff appliances, plush furnishings curated by an interior designer, fitted wardrobes, a separate utility room with washer/dryer, and a spacious bathroom with terrazzo-effect tiling and a rain shower.

Life at Sand House unfolds from the top down. Rooftop terraces invite you to dine, relax or enjoy an open-air cinema. Just below, the 15th-floor Sky Lounge offers elegant spaces for private dining and co-working, wrapped in uninterrupted 360° views of Dublin — city, coast and mountains in every direction. At ground level, a state-of-the-art gym, wellness suite with sauna, flexible co-working spaces and a private screening room complete a home designed around living well.

Beyond the building, Dublin Bay, Irishtown Nature Reserve and the coast are all on your doorstep — for sea swimming, cycling and fresh air whenever you need it. With a dedicated onsite management team, secure bike storage, pet-friendly homes and an onsite Tulu rental station, every detail is considered.

This is Glass Bottle. This is home.
